exposure: Growth Differentiation Factor 15 (GDF15) in cerebrospinal fluid (cGDF15)
outcome: Cortisol (Cortisol Awakening Response, absolute cortisol at awakening postpartum)
cohort: The study included 95 women scheduled for a planned cesarean section, with data collected in late pregnancy and five weeks postpartum.
finding: Pregnancy cGDF15 levels were not associated with self-reported mental well-being or cortisol outcomes postpartum, although pGDF15 levels were associated with estrogens and the overall amount of circulating GDF15 in late pregnancy was strongly related to placenta size.
